name: compliance-file
title: Product compliance file
for_each: select id, code || ' ' || name as name from products where active

sections.title: Product
sections.sql: select code, name, array_to_string(markets, ', ') as markets, owner, coalesce(scip_ref, 'none') as scip_notification from products where id = $1

sections.title: Status by rule
sections.sql: select regulation, status, parts, unknown_parts, failing_parts, listed_parts, exemption_parts from v_product_rule where product_id = $1 order by regulation

sections.title: Every part and its declaration
sections.sql: select pr.part_no, pr.description, pr.supplier, pr.regulation, pr.state, pr.exemption, pr.received_on, pr.document_ref from v_part_rule pr join bom b on b.part_id = pr.part_id where b.product_id = $1 order by pr.part_no, pr.regulation

sections.title: Listed substances
sections.sql: select p.part_no, d.regulation, s.name as substance, s.cas, x.concentration_ppm, x.location from v_part_rule pr join declarations d on d.id = pr.declaration_id join declaration_substances x on x.declaration_id = d.id join substances s on s.id = x.substance_id join parts p on p.id = pr.part_id join bom b on b.part_id = p.id where b.product_id = $1 order by p.part_no

sections.title: Certificates issued
sections.sql: select regulation, issued_to, issued_on, status_at_issue from certificates where product_id = $1 order by issued_on desc

name: article-33
title: REACH Article 33 information
for_each: select distinct p.id, p.code || ' ' || p.name as name from products p join v_svhc v on v.product = p.code

sections.title: Article
sections.sql: select code as product, name, array_to_string(markets, ', ') as markets, coalesce(scip_ref, 'not yet notified') as scip_notification from products where id = $1

sections.title: Candidate List substances above 0.1% weight by weight
sections.note: Supplied under Article 33 of Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006. Concentration is in the part named, which is the article the substance sits in.
sections.sql: select v.part_no, v.substance, v.cas, v.concentration_ppm, v.location from v_svhc v join products p on p.code = v.product where p.id = $1 order by v.part_no

sections.title: Safe use
sections.sql: select 'The substances listed are bound into the part. No release is expected in normal use. Dispose of the product as electrical waste.' as information where $1::uuid is not null

name: supplier-request
title: Declarations requested
for_each: select distinct s.id, s.code || ' ' || s.name as name from suppliers s join v_part_rule pr on pr.supplier_id = s.id where pr.state in ('missing','expired','stale')

sections.title: Supplier
sections.sql: select code, name, contact_name, contact_email, country from suppliers where id = $1

sections.title: Parts we need a current declaration for
sections.sql: select pr.part_no, p.mfr_part_no, pr.description, pr.regulation, pr.state, pr.received_on as last_declared from v_part_rule pr join parts p on p.id = pr.part_id where pr.supplier_id = $1 and pr.state in ('missing','expired','stale') order by pr.part_no, pr.regulation

sections.title: The rules we are asking about
sections.sql: select distinct r.code, r.name, r.source from regulations r join v_part_rule pr on pr.regulation = r.code where pr.supplier_id = $1 and pr.state in ('missing','expired','stale') order by r.code
